title: Calypso Water Park
specs: 35 slides, 100 water games, two theme rivers, heated pools, three children’s areas
Country’s largest wave pool, twice the size of a normal wave pool
Discounts available for groups of 20 or more
Private reserved party areas available for birthday parties
includes: Perks such as free friend tickets, discounts on cabanas, day tickets, parking, restaurants and gift shop depending on pass type
blurb: Calypso Waterpark offers a variety of water attractions including slides, water games, theme rivers, heated pools, children’s areas, and a large wave pool. It is located in Limoges, Ontario, 20 minutes east of Ottawa. Guests can enjoy unlimited visits with season passes and access to other partner parks depending on the pass type.
extraNote: Perks like discounts and priority entry are valid only at Calypso and not at other parks · Summer season, with 2026 season ending and 2027 season upcoming
